title: Usage observation, checkpoint and continuation artifacts, budget state (Story 1.5, lane B)
summary: Second of four lanes for the frozen Story 1.5 in the kit's dispatch adapter: per-harness usage adapters reading the end-of-run result envelope (claude) or reporting NOT_EVALUATED (codex), post-run evaluation against the declared checkpoint and continuation thresholds, a launcher-owned prompt paragraph declaring checkpoint and continuation artifacts and phase boundaries, artifact validation under the kit's redaction rules, a continuation_required thin-result status with loud NEEDS_HUMAN for an invalid artifact, a context_budget member on the dispatch monitor's watch record and status rendering, contract and schema updates, and tests on both harnesses. Frozen launch command texts stay byte-identical. Design judgment calls: adapter interface shape, artifact schemas, boundary declarations, reconciliation of observed usage with the worker's signal. A wrong result misreports budget health or manufactures a completion; no credentials handled.
